Upper-intermediate dictionary acknowledgements

Russian dictionary drafts were adapted and edited from FreeDict English-Russian
2025.11.23 (WikDict/Wiktionary contributors), Creative Commons Attribution-
ShareAlike 3.0 Unported. The adapted Russian dictionary entries retain that
license. The license text is supplied in freedict-LICENSE.txt.
https://freedict.org/
https://www.wikdict.com/
https://download.freedict.org/dictionaries/eng-rus/2025.11.23/
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

Uzbek dictionary reference: qobulovasror/eng-uzb-dictionary.
https://github.com/qobulovasror/eng-uzb-dictionary

Dictionary senses were selected using lesson context and supplemented with
manually written translations and corrections. Existing WORDLY translations
were reused where appropriate. No textbook content was sent to a translation API.

Pronunciation fallback uses CMUdict; see cmudict-LICENSE.txt.
Textbook pages and covers are from the PDF supplied by the project owner;
the dictionary license does not apply to the textbook.
